subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should embedded after-compaction hooks gain this current-session-only deferred reset API as a supported plugin contract, and should it be exposed on the generic hook context or only on after-compaction contexts?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and safety-scoped, but adding a permanent plugin API and choosing its hook visibility are compatibility decisions not established by current main or the closed broader proposal.

options.title: Approve compaction-only API
options.body: Expose the deferred reset capability only on embedded after-compaction contexts, document the contract, and merge after positive lifecycle proof.

options.title: Approve generic hook API
options.body: Keep the API on generic embedded hook contexts and explicitly document which hook phases may call it and when queued resets drain.

options.title: Keep reset internal
options.body: Do not add a plugin contract; provide an owner-specific compaction lifecycle seam for the affected context engine instead.

recommendation.title: Approve compaction-only API
recommendation.body: Expose the deferred reset capability only on embedded after-compaction contexts, document the contract, and merge after positive lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent context-engine maintenance and plugin-owned compaction work most directly matches the lifecycle ownership decision.
